The proof does not confuse geometric sphere homotopy with PL sphere homeomorphism.

originality.rationale: Primary sources were compared by mathematical implication and exact group actions. Singh 2020 covers the trivial-subgroup balanced square case; Reiner–Roberts 2000 supplies characteristic-zero homology only; Jojić et al. 2016 impose a different column bound; accessible own related fixed-point work concerns part-exchanging involutions. The new result determines a previously unlocated family of geometric fixed-point homotopy types for every product subgroup, not just Betti numbers. An unindexed equivalent rectangular homotopy theorem remains a stated risk.
residual_risks: The equal-sided square homotopy type and the specific staged Morse technique are explicitly not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The infinite fixed-space classification captures every side-preserving product subgroup and its empty/nonempty transition, with nontrivial homotopy sphere dimension controlled solely by orbit numbers. These geometric fixed spaces are natural invariants in equivariant homotopy and not implied by known non-equivariant homotopy or characteristic-zero homology representations. It is more than the underlying square-case reproving or a narrow finite table.
